title: verifier.preparation_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs EvaluatorAgent to prepare (verifier-first) a VerifierSpec for the frozen BenchmarkSpec and ResearchSpec. EvaluatorAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M7) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.
